text: Which system integration specialists in Hobart are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

result.keyword: Which system integration specialists in Hobart are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?
result.markdown:
For a business in Hobart looking to connect ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP and Microsoft 365, I’d shortlist specialists based on **proven experience integrating the actual platforms**, not just general IT support.

One important distinction: implementing an ERP and integrating it with other systems are different skills. You want a partner who can map data flows, build or configure APIs and connectors, handle error recovery, and maintain the integrations after launch.

## Best-fit specialists to investigate

![MYOB Acumatica AI Studio](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAlrTGCrfl4CY2Q8lCKP01snPtLtov-7DGZrYmOUNZEE741elzE1h4T6abMz-o7r54SoegSQmDPp9cmKLcgKYbw3QewJYAF4R7zQny4MMKEL_g4lypb3gqi-wjuWwua3a1yDyDlG78E2YUmCqq6lGimDuXFM4PJOgEfE3Fqv17W_Uj73F-cgO7m17vXW_iTY?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. BusinessHub

(Best for MYOB Acumatica)

BusinessHub is a strong first call if MYOB Acumatica is your core ERP. It is an MYOB Platinum Partner with a Hobart office, and specialises in ERP implementation, business process improvement and related integrations. [www.myob.com](https://www.myob.com/au/implementation-partners/businesshub?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.localsearch.com.au](https://www.localsearch.com.au/profile/businesshub/cmkfi1rzj01ld02ldcv6q38zq?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them\:** Can you integrate our current CRM, SAP and Microsoft 365 environment with MYOB Acumatica, and which parts would require another specialist?

Contact: 1300 733 071 · [Website](https://businesshub.com.au/)

---

![Onix office photos | Glassdoor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p2po9wpeKzHj20c6gRR3vpCYPWRbzOTutYbwrfI7dykn69jslmOJ0RzsOwbT0heYHLCRWyLBPeg32GwMwdHDkcjfklQSrCoUJ5h8K-HEoxryaXMsFjjV6s9ob7zPdQwrdt3vB9qbOekyIzYhUQkkxOnJdYKkb2D6z17AnilErUYD1TjzA2_W5NgJgaPvzUu5?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Tempus Innovative Solutions

(Best for cross-system integration)

Tempus explicitly offers ERP, CRM, finance, inventory, SharePoint and Microsoft 365-related solutions, as well as integration and automation. It also works with government and larger organisations on enterprise integration projects. This makes it a promising candidate for connecting multiple existing platforms. [tempusis.com.au](https://tempusis.com.au/integration-and-automation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tempusis.com.au](https://tempusis.com.au/software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tempusis.com.au](https://tempusis.com.au/large-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them\:** Have you delivered a production integration involving SAP and MYOB Acumatica specifically, and what middleware would you use?

Location: North Hobart · [Website](https://tempusis.com.au/)

---

![Business Consultancy | Prospera Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66P9XqF4D93LyMn5ZIjF1fD_1KOnjFtLXY9W9OfD6CHmH4qbCKj6lYWYeW3D9RFg8Tw9g2p_JVvnGNPXiaYTF5H1Mcg5Ki8faK7ZYNgca87LXY-MzhjNNSDDWdX_MjO8Kdk3akBYBB5qqp1SWWFAi84DOtHQOa2XCRi5h6MSRIYjzptETQI08Bdt6YvhnQ9L?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Buftec

(Best for bespoke integrations)

Buftec is a locally based, independent consultancy with more than 25 years of hands-on production experience across applications, databases, APIs, automation and legacy systems. It could suit a project requiring custom integration between systems that do not have ready-made connectors. [buftec.com](https://buftec.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them\:** Can you design and support the API or middleware layer, including monitoring, retries, data reconciliation and recovery when an integration fails?

Contact: 0408 474 353 · clancy\@buftec.com · [Website](https://www.buftec.com/)

---

![DataWise Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-9bXEZFrizeQieGk2j8-pzI38lPoTSklIfaD7v1mHEzEHGcPYRoMVpjUYac9Oz2FSugj_QAR67ZlxZZug6GbUK8VyE5tEnllCFi91rJroFDurBNFZl74YoEZC6XeNx99xS-4tR9M4QWWzZGLXlcoaJUMkroLyKCpEkZ4ohSYb16NJgl6Rtp1p0Xbe6a2hLYh?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Datawise Consulting

A local option for the Microsoft and custom-software side of the project. Datawise offers Microsoft-focused IT consulting, software development, business reporting and integrated solutions, with experience in cloud and application architecture. [datawise.com.au](https://datawise.com.au/about/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[datawise.com.au](https://datawise.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them\:** Can you own the Microsoft 365, SharePoint, identity and custom API work while coordinating with our ERP vendor?

Contact: 03 6224 1231 · [Website](https://datawise.com.au/)

---

![MYOB Acumatica Partner](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KSetADfOoCLAoBRqlbudPrUa7oCp6h--ANkdBxC85z0nKuKt1dLqR7MHVE6R6MXG82N4bT8iE3EkCeb5ndJertJtkRtmS9kgVMU5Q0Q39u-K8Rzgr4BSIRR2vu8De1qTrnNmMsM7BpRvRUhQbqiFEmYoLtwUHwI8GN-1lCZYEcU3tLhKZSR0lFJgsb0MSBy_?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Stratus Consulting Group

Worth considering as a national ERP implementation and integration partner that serves Tasmania. Stratus is an MYOB Diamond Partner with dedicated implementation, development and support teams. A published case study documents its integration of Salesforce with MYOB Acumatica for St John Ambulance Tasmania, alongside other operational systems. [www.myob.com](https://www.myob.com/au/implementation-partners/stratus-group?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[stratusgroup.com.au](https://stratusgroup.com.au/hubfs/Case%20Studies/St%20John%20Ambulance%20Tasmania%20Case%20Study%20final.pdf?hsLang=en-au&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them\:** Can you provide an integration architect with direct experience connecting SAP, MYOB Acumatica and Microsoft 365 in one environment?

Contact: 1300 499 000 · [Website](https://stratusgroup.com.au/)

## How I would rank them for your project

| Your main requirement | First company to approach |
|--------|--------|
| MYOB Acumatica implementation and ERP integration | BusinessHub |
| Connecting multiple existing systems | Tempus Innovative Solutions |
| Custom APIs, middleware and legacy applications | Buftec |
| Microsoft 365 and bespoke application development | Datawise Consulting |
| ERP implementation with a documented Salesforce integration | Stratus Consulting Group |


This is a **fit-based shortlist, not a verified ranking of overall quality**\. Public information supports their general capabilities, but I could not verify that any one firm has demonstrated experience with every pairing in your exact stack, particularly SAP-to-MYOB Acumatica integration.

## What to ask before choosing

Request a technical discovery session with your shortlisted firms and have them answer these questions\:

- **ERP and CRM\:** Which system owns customers, products, pricing, orders and financial records?
- **SAP and MYOB Acumatica\:** Have you connected these exact platforms in production? Can you provide a relevant case study or reference?
- **Microsoft 365\:** Can you integrate with Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Microsoft Entra ID where needed?
- **Architecture\:** Would you use native connectors, APIs, an integration platform or custom middleware? Why?
- **Support\:** Who monitors failed synchronisations, resolves duplicate records and handles upgrades?
- **Delivery\:** Can you provide a fixed-scope discovery phase, architecture diagram, implementation plan and ongoing support pricing?

A particularly relevant starting point is to investigate the available MYOB Salesforce Connector if Salesforce is your CRM: MYOB documents bidirectional synchronisation for several business records, although its supported data flows have limitations. [www.myob.com](https://www.myob.com/au/apps/myob-salesforce-connector?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
